text.arabic_uthmani: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ رِيحًۭا صَرْصَرًۭا فِى يَوْمِ نَحْسٍۢ مُّسْتَمِرٍّۢ

words.gloss_range: emphatic opening particle with attached first-person plural divine self-reference
words.prose: {{ar:إِنَّا}} ({{tr:innā}}) makes the punishment report begin as emphatic divine declaration, not as a bare historical notice. Its attached speaker form fixes agency before the verb arrives: the same first-person plural authority will reappear inside the sending verb, so certainty, speaker, and act are tightly coupled in one recited launch. The opening also answers the prior question boundary from 54:18 and prepares the surah's repeated dispatch scenes at 54:27, 54:31, and 54:34.

topics.headline: emphatic declaration frames the whole report
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah starts by certifying the punishment report before naming the mechanism.
topics.reason: The particle opens an inna clause whose predicate is the sending report, so the emphatic force scopes the whole declaration and answers the prior question boundary.

topics.headline: attached speaker concentrates divine agency
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the speaker is grammatically fixed and majestic before the action is stated.
topics.reason: The attached first-person plural pronoun is the governed ism of the particle and aligns with the first-person plural verbal agency that follows; the plural marks divine authority rather than multiple agents.

topics.headline: assertion and self-reference arrive fused
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the opening as a single compact launch where emphasis and speaker are not separated.
topics.reason: The written-recited unit fuses the particle and pronoun, and the long final vowel gives the emphatic self-reference audible weight.

topics.headline: opening points into a repeated dispatch pattern
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that divine agency is fronted before a sending pattern that will recur with different sent agents in the surah.
topics.reason: The speaker-fronted opening precedes the first local dispatch scene and the supplied inter-ayah row links the sending root to 54:27, 54:31, and 54:34.

words.gloss_range: caused dispatch in a completed divine punishment report
words.root_gloss_range: broad field of sending, release, message, and easy flow; the local Form IV verb selects caused dispatch while message and release remain secondary pressures
words.prose: {{ar:أَرْسَلْنَا}} ({{tr:arsalnā}}) turns the emphatic speaker into a completed act: a wind is actively dispatched upon the target, not merely described as weather. The Form IV shape of {{ar:ر س ل}} ({{tr:r-s-l}}) makes release a caused sending, while messenger-like mission pressure survives only as punishment dispatch because the object is wind and the prepositional frame is hostile. The wording also joins the 41:16 wind formula and the surah's pattern of different sent agents at 54:27, 54:31, and 54:34.

topics.headline: sending is aimed against a target
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees a layered frame: divine sender, wind as object, and the people as the target upon whom it falls.
topics.reason: The verb has an explicit direct object and a governed hostile target phrase, so the dispatch is not neutral communication toward recipients.

topics.headline: perfect Form IV makes dispatch accomplished
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the punishment is narrated as an accomplished divine act with causation built into the form.
topics.reason: The perfect Form IV verb encodes completed caused sending, and the first-person plural suffix keeps the divine agent inside the word.

topics.headline: messenger semantics survive as dispatch logic
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the destructive wind is treated as a sent agent with a mission-like logic, while the local object keeps the sense as punishment dispatch.
topics.reason: The root family includes message and messenger branches, but the local direct object is wind and the target frame is hostile; therefore message is a semantic pressure, not the selected sense.

topics.headline: wind dispatch belongs to a repeated punishment formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears this sending as part of a recognizable wind-punishment formula and a wider surah sequence of dispatched agents.
topics.reason: The supplied rows connect the phrase closely with 41:16 and with later dispatch scenes in the same surah.

topics.headline: verb pivots from speaker to concrete mechanism
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the clause move from divine self-reference into the named mechanism of punishment.
topics.reason: The verb is the hinge that converts the opening assertion and the prior abstract punishment question into a concrete dispatched instrument.

words.gloss_range: prepositional target phrase meaning upon or against them, with the suffix referring back to Aad in 54:18
words.prose: {{ar:عَلَيْهِمْ}} ({{tr:ʿalayhim}}) marks the recipients as the pressured target of the sending, not as neutral addressees. The suffix carries Aad forward from 54:18 without renaming them, so the people are definite but compressed into the pressure marker itself. Its position before the wind foregrounds the affected group before the instrument is named and sets up the bodily aftermath in 54:20.

topics.headline: upon marks pressure against the target
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the sending falls upon the group as burden and hostility, not simply toward them as a message.
topics.reason: The governed preposition functions as the affected target complement of the sending verb and supports both spatial superposition and adversarial force.

topics.headline: suffix carries Aad from the previous ayah
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the named people from 54:18 are now reduced to a definite pronoun inside the punishment sentence.
topics.reason: The masculine plural suffix is resolved by the bundle to Aad from 54:18, making the target definite without repeating the name.

topics.headline: target is named before the wind
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah completes the target beat before naming the instrument and then moves toward the visible result in 54:20.
topics.reason: The target phrase closes the actor-act-target unit before the wind phrase and binds the 54:18 antecedent to the 54:20 aftermath.

words.gloss_range: an indefinite singular wind as the dispatched object, qualified by the following harsh adjective
words.root_gloss_range: broad field of wind, spirit, breath, rest, scent, and invisible motion; the local sense is physical wind with invisible-force pressure retained
words.prose: {{ar:رِيحًۭا}} ({{tr:rīḥan}}) is the object actually sent, an indefinite singular wind whose type is immediately fixed by the following harsh adjective. The {{ar:ر و ح}} ({{tr:r-w-ḥ}}) field lets the reader feel invisible breath-force behind the physical wind, and even relief associations are inverted into harm, but local grammar keeps the selected sense concrete. The singular destructive wind also belongs to the Aad punishment pattern, especially 41:16 and 69:6, and its unseen movement is made sensory by the next word.

topics.headline: indefinite wind is the dispatched object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the punishment instrument is a category-bearing sent wind, not a named familiar wind.
topics.reason: The noun is accusative as direct object, indefinite, singular, and qualified by the next adjective as part of the same object phrase.

topics.headline: breath and spirit pressure remains under physical wind
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the wind as an invisible moving force, while the local adjective and object role keep it from becoming spirit rather than wind.
topics.reason: The root field includes spirit, breath, rest, and wind, but the local concrete noun plus following adjective selects destructive physical wind and leaves other branches as pressure.

topics.headline: wind belongs to the Aad punishment motif
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes the wind as part of a recurrent Aad punishment configuration rather than isolated weather.
topics.reason: The rows tie the wind to close punishment-wind parallels at 41:16, 69:6, and other Aad storm contexts.

topics.headline: unseen wind receives sensory completion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the movement from unseen air to audible, abrasive, and then visible devastation.
topics.reason: The wind noun is immediately qualified by the harsh adjective and then leads toward the visible aftermath in 54:20.

words.gloss_range: harsh reduplicated adjective of the wind, carrying shrieking and biting-cold force
words.root_gloss_range: rare reduplicated field of harsh sound, cold, and repeated intensity; all are locally tied to the wind as its adjective
words.prose: {{ar:صَرْصَرًۭا}} ({{tr:ṣarṣaran}}) locks the wind into a specific sensory type: shrieking, biting, and recursively severe. Because it agrees with the wind in case and indefiniteness, the quality belongs to the dispatched object itself. The doubled shape of {{ar:ص ر ص ر}} ({{tr:ṣ-r-ṣ-r}}) lets sound, cold, and repetition reinforce one another, and the rare distribution ties the word to the Aad wind scenes in 41:16 and 69:6.

topics.headline: quality is locked to the sent wind
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the harshness is not a separate event but the defining quality of the sent object.
topics.reason: Agreement in accusative case and indefiniteness binds the adjective to the wind inside the object phrase.

topics.headline: shrieking and cold strike together
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the wind as an attack on hearing and touch at once.
topics.reason: The supplied semantic field keeps shrieking sound and intense cold together, and neither branch is contradicted by the local wind context.

topics.headline: reduplication performs repeated harshness
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the repeated cluster as part of the word's meaning, not as decoration.
topics.reason: The reduplicated quadriliteral form repeats the phonetic unit and supports recurrence and intensification.

topics.headline: rare adjective marks the Aad wind field
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes the adjective as a specialized marker of this destruction narrative across 54:19, 41:16, and 69:6.
topics.reason: The supplied distribution gives only a tiny set of aligned Aad wind-punishment occurrences, so rarity and collocation are meaningful.

words.gloss_range: preposition introducing the closing temporal frame
words.prose: {{ar:فِى}} ({{tr:fī}}) pivots the ayah from the sent instrument to the time-container in which the dispatch occurs. Because it comes after the wind phrase, time arrives as a closing frame rather than an opening setting. That frame participates in the surah's repeated day-language at 54:6, 54:8, 54:19, and 54:48.

topics.headline: preposition opens the closing time frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah's beat shift from instrument to time only after the wind has been specified.
topics.reason: The preposition governs the following day noun and postposes the temporal frame after the object phrase.

topics.headline: time phrase enters the surah's day thread
topics.reader_payoff: The reader connects this temporal frame to the surah's escalating characterizations of day and reckoning.
topics.reason: The supplied inter-ayah row links the day language in 54:19 with 54:6, 54:8, and the later reckoning frame.

words.gloss_range: governed construct day forming the temporal container for misfortune
words.root_gloss_range: broad range from day to marked time-period, with heat and temporal pressure in the background; local grammar selects a bounded temporal frame
words.prose: {{ar:يَوْمِ}} ({{tr:yawmi}}) is the governed day-frame, not another object: it places the sending inside a marked time-container. As a construct head it is bound to the following misfortune, so the day is defined by that quality; variant evidence shows how different the phrase would feel if the bond were loosened into an adjectival reading. The {{ar:ي و م}} ({{tr:y-w-m}}) range allows more than a calendar label, and the singular here concentrates the 41:16 plural-days parallel into one severe temporal unit.

topics.headline: day is the governed temporal locus
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees time as a syntactic participant that frames the dispatched punishment rather than a loose date.
topics.reason: The noun is genitive under the preposition and functions as the temporal complement of the sending frame.

topics.headline: construct binds day to misfortune
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that misfortune defines the day from inside the noun phrase, not as a detachable comment.
topics.reason: The standard construct form lacks article and tanwin and takes the following genitive as its specifying dependent.

topics.headline: variant exposes the phrase's pressure point
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that a small reading difference shifts the relation between day and misfortune from possession-like construct to direct description.
topics.reason: The variant is useful contrast, but the local standard parse remains construct with the following genitive.

topics.headline: day can carry harsh temporal scale
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the day as a bounded but weighty span of adversity, not merely a calendar date.
topics.reason: The root range permits broader temporal scale and heat pressure, while local grammar confines the word to the marked time-frame of this dispatch.

topics.headline: singular day concentrates wider time echoes
topics.reader_payoff: The reader connects this day to the surah's recurring time pressure and to the plural-days framing of 41:16.
topics.reason: The supplied rows connect the word with local day references and with the cross-surah singular-plural contrast against 41:16.

words.gloss_range: genitive misfortune or ill-omen specifying the day
words.root_gloss_range: rare field of ill-omen and concrete copper or smoke-like materiality; local grammar selects adverse temporal quality while material density remains secondary pressure
words.prose: {{ar:نَحْسٍ}} ({{tr:naḥsin}}) is the qualitative core of the closing phrase: the day is specified as a day of misfortune, and the final participle can let that misfortune or the day-frame carry continuity. The variant adjective reading shows how the phrase could make the day itself actively ill-omened, but the standard construct keeps misfortune as the genitive specifying quality. The rare {{ar:ن ح س}} ({{tr:n-ḥ-s}}) field also brings material heaviness from the copper or smoke-like branch, while the local sense remains ill-omened adversity; its tight sound and collocational links gather the ayah's sending, wind, harsh qualifier, and day into one adverse closure.

topics.headline: misfortune specifies the day
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that misfortune is the defining quality inside the temporal phrase, not a separate event beside it.
topics.reason: The word is genitive as the construct dependent of the day noun and mediates between the day and the final persistence qualifier.

topics.headline: continuity can qualify misfortune or the day-frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the closing continuity can be heard as belonging to the misfortune itself or to the day defined by it.
topics.reason: Agreement permits the final participle to be read with the misfortune or the larger temporal frame, and the word is tightly bound to the day pairing.

topics.headline: variant tests noun versus adjective force
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that a vowel difference can shift adversity from a possessed quality to a direct active description of the day.
topics.reason: The variant adjectival reading is valid as contrast, but the standard local form remains the genitive noun in construct.

topics.headline: rare root gives misfortune material density
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels ill-omen as dense and weighty because the rare root also reaches toward copper or smoke-like materiality.
topics.reason: The material branch is attested in the supplied root field and cross-reference, but the local temporal construct selects ill-omened adversity as the surface sense.

topics.headline: rare misfortune gathers the ayah's roots
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes this word as a compact nexus where the sending, wind, harsh qualifier, and day converge.
topics.reason: The supplied co-occurrence rows place the other major content roots of the ayah inside the rare misfortune network.

topics.headline: tight sound supports adverse closure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears constriction and rarity reinforcing the adverse quality assigned to the day.
topics.reason: The tight consonantal close and low occurrence profile support the word's specialized adverse force without changing the grammar.

words.gloss_range: Form X active participle marking continuing, unrelenting adversity at the ayah's close
words.root_gloss_range: field of passing through, continuation, bitterness, and tautness; local form selects continuing persistence while bitter and tightened pressure remain active
words.prose: {{ar:مُسْتَمِرٍّ}} ({{tr:mustamirrin}}) closes the ayah by making persistence a standing quality, not a momentary afterthought. Its genitive agreement can attach continuity to the misfortune or to the day-frame, so the ending leaves the whole temporal phrase unrelenting. The {{ar:م ر ر}} ({{tr:m-r-r}}) field lets continuation feel like bitter passage and taut refusal to release; the final cadence and doubled consonant seal that persistence, while the same-surah echo with 54:2 and 54:46 links denial-language to consequence-language.

topics.headline: participle makes persistence a standing quality
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah lands on ongoing adversity rather than on the wind alone.
topics.reason: The Form X active participle functions as the final adjective and turns duration into an active, ongoing attribute.

topics.headline: continuity can attach to misfortune or day
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the final persistence spreading over both possible heads of the closing phrase.
topics.reason: Genitive concord keeps the word grammatically bound inside the temporal phrase and leaves the head relation locally open.

topics.headline: continuation carries bitter and taut pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the duration as acrid, passing through, and tightened, while the local form still selects persistence.
topics.reason: The root field includes passing, bitterness, and rope-tightening imagery, but the Form X participle locally selects continuing duration.

topics.headline: rare participle echoes denial and later bitterness
topics.reader_payoff: The reader connects continuous misfortune here with the earlier continuous-magic claim in 54:2 and the later bitter consequence at 54:46.
topics.reason: The supplied distribution marks the active participle as rare and concentrated in the surah alongside the earlier same-form echo and later bitterness.

topics.headline: final sound seals persistence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the closing cadence and doubled final consonant bind misfortune to persistence.
topics.reason: The final position, genitive ending, and doubled consonant make the ayah close with acoustic weight that matches semantic persistence.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: أَرْسَلْنَا ... رِيحًا صَرْصَرًا ... يَوْمِ نَحْسٍ مُّسْتَمِرٍّ
baseline_models.mechanism: Release is coupled to air as an overpowering medium, doubled cold and sounding qualities, a day construed as the descended crisis, and continued passage: this is a directed force operating through time, not weather merely present.

activation_trace.role: Sending and release, explicitly including winds, supplies the directed launch rather than a weather state.
Wind, breeze, and moving air supply the event's physical carrier.
Wind as force and dominance turns the carrier into an overpowering agent.
Stridulating sound gives the wind an abrasive acoustic edge.
A cold ṣarṣar wind supplies the immediate thermal violence.
A day as a severe descending event makes time itself the catastrophe's frame.
Severe cold and cold wind reinforce the thermal reading beyond abstract ill fortune.
Proceeding, passing, and penetrating supply the event's continuing traversal.

changed_reading.before: A harsh wind happened throughout an unlucky day.
changed_reading.after: A deliberately released force of cold, sounding air keeps traversing and penetrating its victims through a day that has itself become the calamity.

baseline_models.mechanism: Succession in dispatch, recurrence within time, and the image of a tightly twisted cord make continuity dynamically composite: repeated passes can be bound into one sustained duration.

activation_trace.role: Successive groups or cuts supply a serial pulse to the dispatch.
A duration of time contains the serial action without requiring a single instant.
Occurrence by times and repetitions supplies recurrent strokes within the duration.
A tightly twisted cord supplies the exploratory image of gusts coupled into one barrage.

changed_reading.before: Continuous means one undifferentiated long interval.
changed_reading.after: Continuity can be heard as successive, tightly coupled passes: a barrage whose repeated strokes are held inside one duration.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding punishment-and-warning refrain activates the message branch of sending: the wind does penal work while also becoming the delivered warning itself.

activation_trace.role: Messenger and message give the sending communicative force in addition to transport.
Painful punishment supplies the sent event's penal function.
Warning that awakens caution supplies the communicative function embodied by the wind.

structural_cues: 54:18's refrain directly precedes 54:19, whose emphatic opening answers it with a transitive dispatch.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies punishment, warning, and the message branch of sending; I infer that one physical event performs both functions. A live alternative is that the warning names prior speech while the wind only executes punishment.

changed_reading.before: The wind is only the instrument that implements a punishment.
changed_reading.after: The wind is also a dispatched, bodily legible warning: message and penalty arrive in the same medium.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next ayah exposes the wind's continuous operation as extraction from emplacement: it plucks people out and leaves body-bases comparable to palms torn from their roots.

activation_trace.role: Wind as force and dominance supplies the causal power behind the extraction.
Continued passage becomes an ongoing operation through bodies and terrain.
Plucking a thing from its settled place states the wind's operative action.
The rear or base of a thing supplies the bodily remnant and trunk orientation.
The palm tree supplies the upright organic substrate of the comparison.
Removal from the root completes the extraction mechanism and its terminal state.

structural_cues: 54:20 opens with present-tense تَنزِعُ and no newly named agent; the nearest available agent is the wind in 54:19.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies force, continued passage, active plucking, body-bases, palms, and uprooting; I assign the wind as the omitted subject and read continuity as its ongoing operation. A live alternative is that مُّسْتَمِرٍّ qualifies only the ill fortune or day.

changed_reading.before: The wind persists around the people.
changed_reading.after: The wind persists by working through them, repeatedly overcoming emplacement until upright bodies become uprooted bases.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later pairing of assay and endurance activates a side branch in ص ب ر for severe winter cold, joining the focus ayah's two independent cold branches and recasting cold as pressure that tests bodily holding.

activation_trace.role: The explicitly cold ṣarṣar wind supplies the first thermal anchor.
Severe cold and cold wind supply a second, independent thermal anchor.
Assaying metal or a person supplies the testing function assigned to the cold pressure.
Severe winter cold links endurance lexically to the focus ayah's doubled cold.

structural_cues: 54:27 places a declared trial and a command to endure within one sequence in the packet's next narrative cycle.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two focus-cold branches plus assay and winter-cold branches in the later trial; I infer a cross-episode image of cold testing the capacity to hold. The live alternative is that the winter-cold branch is irrelevant to the imperative's contextual sense.

changed_reading.before: Cold is one descriptive property of the punishing wind.
changed_reading.after: Cold becomes the ordeal's testing pressure, probing whether embodied stance can hold before the wind extracts it.

context_deltas.mechanism: A later repetition of the dispatch formula substitutes one terrifying cry for the ṣarṣar wind. This makes the focus wind's sound branch functional and distinguishes a sustained acoustic-air traversal from a single acoustic impulse, both ending in organic fragmentation.

activation_trace.role: Stridulating sound supplies an acoustic component inside the wind.
Ongoing passage gives the focus event its sustained temporal profile.
The repeated release-and-dispatch image establishes the same action frame with a different payload.
A terrifying cry supplies the comparison event's explicitly acoustic payload.
One in number marks the comparison event as a single impulse against sustained passage.
Dry broken vegetation supplies the later dispatch's fragmented organic residue.

structural_cues: 54:31 repeats إِنَّا أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ, substitutes صَيْحَةً وَاحِدَةً for رِيحًا صَرْصَرًا, and states a broken-material result.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated dispatch frame, sound branches, singularity, sustained passage, and broken vegetation; I infer a deliberate modality and duration comparison. A live alternative is that the episodes merely reuse formulaic diction without making ṣarṣar acoustically functional.

changed_reading.before: Ṣarṣar only intensifies the wind's harshness or cold.
changed_reading.after: The wind is both cold and acoustically weaponized; unlike the later single cry, its destructive sound travels continuously with moving air.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it reverses the usual comfort field of ر و ح; it remains anchored in رِيحًا and in packet branches for rest and death phrased as relief, with نَحْسٍ blocking a benign result. Render only as lexical irony, not as a replacement gloss for wind.

activation_trace.role: Rest and regained breath supply the comfort field that the verse reverses.
Death expressed as giving relief supplies the lethal endpoint of that reversal.
Ill fortune turns the expected relief field toward its adverse extreme.

changed_reading.before: The wind belongs only to a meteorological vocabulary.
changed_reading.after: The life-and-relief root field is inverted: what could restore breath becomes the medium of final relief through death.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising and form-distant because عَادٌ is a proper name, not an assertion of return; it remains packet-licensed through the ع و د mapping and anchored by مُّسْتَمِرٍّ branches of recurrence. Render only as a name-triggered pattern resonance, never as the lexical translation of the name.

activation_trace.role: Return after departure supplies a cycle image activated by the named subject.
Repeated occurrence anchors the return image in the focus ayah's temporal descriptor.
Successive dispatch supplies the mechanism by which a punitive pattern can recur.

changed_reading.before: The ayah reports one isolated historical dispatch.
changed_reading.after: The proper name activates an exploratory return-pattern: dispatch and calamity recur in successive instantiations rather than remaining a sealed event.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it imports water apportionment from the next episode into the focus ayah's time phrase; it remains anchored in يَوْمِ and مُّسْتَمِرٍّ and supported by explicit branches for partition, water-share, and attendance. Render as an analogy of administered timing, not as a claim that the day literally is a ration.

activation_trace.role: A duration of time supplies the interval available for apportionment.
Repeated temporal occurrence supplies the returning-turn structure.
Separating and assigning a portion supplies the administrative mechanism.
An allotted water-share supplies the concrete model of a scheduled turn.
Presence and attendance make each allotted turn an appointed, realized interval.

changed_reading.before: The day is merely the date or container of the event.
changed_reading.after: The day can be imagined as an allotted turn in an administered sequence, with recurrence governed rather than accidental.

strongest_changes: Sending becomes communicative: the wind delivers the warning while executing punishment.
Continuation becomes an extraction process, clarified by the active uprooting of people into palm-like bases.
The doubled cold field becomes an exploratory assay of bodily endurance.
The later single cry makes ṣarṣar's acoustic branch functional and sharpens sustained versus impulsive dispatch.
summary.what_was_special: The focus ayah binds agency, medium, sound, cold, temporal crisis, and passage unusually tightly; nearby roots then expose the wind as message, extraction engine, endurance pressure, and one member of a medium-switching dispatch pattern.
remaining_uncertainties: مُّسْتَمِرٍّ may grammatically characterize the ill fortune or day rather than the wind's operation.
The relative weight of ṣarṣar's sound and cold branches remains unresolved; the trace carries both.
The cold-endurance, proper-name return, and apportioned-time readings are cross-episode activations, not secure contextual glosses.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **The wind is released as a cold, force-bearing agent.** `ر س ل` B001 is being sent forth/released; `ر و ح` B003 is wind and moving air, while B011 is force and dominance; `ص ر ص ر` B004 is a bitterly cold wind; `ن ح س` B002 is ill cold. The packet layers cold and adverse force onto the same dispatched medium. I infer that the wind is not scenery but an agent whose temperature and momentum jointly produce the next ayah’s extraction. The ayah reads as a specified physical mechanism of punishment.

2. **`مُّسْتَمِرٍّ` again preserves passage and recurrence, now sharpened by bitterness.** `م ر ر` B001 is passing through, B002 repeated occurrence, B003 bitter taste, and B004 bitter severity/calamity. The day contains a moving wind yet is itself marked by continuing misfortune. I infer that motion through time, sustained recurrence, and severe bitterness overlap without becoming identical. The word can mark an unbroken adverse span while echoing the wind’s bitter cold.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Later 54:38’s `مُّسْتَقِرٌّ` supplies a direct counter-state to this `مُّسْتَمِرٍّ`: passing or recurrent adversity reaches settlement. Later 54:46 also activates bitterness in `م ر ر`, confirming that the cold day’s duration and severity are intentionally layered.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **`ر س ل / B001` (being sent forth and released) with `ر و ح / B011` (power, force, and dominance), grounded in `B003` (wind).** The grammar does not present ambient weather; it dispatches wind as a released force. Its next action is to pull people out in 54:20. The packet supplies sending -> wind -> extraction; I infer directed dispatch -> converts moving air into a counter-dominance. **Reading change:** `رِيحًا` is an envoy of force within the warning's execution.
2. **`ن ح س / B003` (drought dust and rising dust), beside `B001` (misfortune and ill omen).** Uprooted palm trunks in 54:20 give the day an ecological texture of dry, exposed matter rather than abstract bad luck. The branch assigns dust the role of visible medium through which the wind's stripping force manifests. The packet supplies wind and uprooted vegetation; I infer uprooting -> raises/desiccates debris. **Reading change:** `يَوْمِ نَحْسٍ` becomes a material drought-and-dust environment.
3. **`م ر ر / B006` (firm strength and resolve), coactivated with `B001` (continuing onward).** `مُسْتَمِرّ` modifies a day whose wind keeps extracting people. The branch gives persistence tensile force: the event neither slackens nor yields before completing its operation. The packet supplies ongoing extraction; I infer continuity -> unbroken effective pressure. **Reading change:** the day is not merely long or repeated; it holds a firm course.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 54:20 made the wind's force visible as extraction, dust, and uprooted remnants; 54:22 then corrected raw scattering by gathering the event back into recitable order.

baseline.text: Onların üzerine, süregelen uğursuz bir günde çok sert bir rüzgâr gönderdik.

findings.text: Rüzgâr, soğuğu ve hareket kuvveti birlikte işleyen, sonraki ayetteki sökme eylemini gerçekleştirmek üzere gönderilmiş bir etkendir.
Süregelen gün, zaman içinde kesintisiz ilerlemeyi, yinelenen uğursuzluğu ve acı şiddeti aynı süre içinde üst üste bindirir.
Sökülmüş hurmaların çevresi, uğursuz günü rüzgârla yükselen kuru toz ve çıplak bitki kalıntılarıyla maddi bir ortama dönüştürebilir; bu bağlantı dolaylıdır.
Süregitme, rüzgârın işi tamamlanıncaya kadar gevşemeyen kararlı basıncını da çağrıştırır.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P2 - Wind Extraction and Vegetal Disassembly
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A released force pulls upright bodies from emplacement and reduces them to dry, broken vegetal remains.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The punishments share one mechanical sequence: release, extraction, loss of rootedness, and brittle fragmentation.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: A freezing force is released
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A shrill, cold wind is sent through a sustained adverse interval.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: release or send `quranic:root_000563:B001/m01`; wind `quranic:root_000609:B003/m01`; wind as force `quranic:root_000609:B011/m01`; shrill sound `quranic:root_000857:B002/m01`; freezing wind `quranic:root_000857:B004/m01`; cold wind `quranic:root_001480:B002/m01`; dust-bearing drought `quranic:root_001480:B003/m01`; sustained passage `quranic:root_001414:B001/m02`.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The wind is a dispatched, acoustically harsh extraction force rather than neutral weather.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P1-P4 - Earlier Descriptions Become Judgment States
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A term first used as accusation, abstraction, or forecast returns in a later pericope as an objective condition fixed by judgment.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The surah makes provisional language anticipatory: speakers and events eventually inhabit the states that earlier words only alleged or announced.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: P1 -> P2 same-root reversal: continuous moves from claim to event
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: P1 attaches persistence to a dismissive magic claim; P2 transfers the same form to the adverse day in which the wind arrives.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: deceptive diversion `quranic:root_000682:B002/m01`; P1 sustained-passage label `quranic:root_001414:B001/m01`; ill-omened day `quranic:root_001480:B001/m01`; P2 sustained passage `quranic:root_001414:B001/m02`.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The P1-P2 bridge is a same-root role reversal. What observers call continuously manipulative becomes objectively continuous adversity, transferring persistence from their dismissal to the event they cannot dismiss.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A herd remains viable through directed group movement between scouted pasture, water, and return.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Pastoral order supplies a concrete model for the surah's collective motion: sending, gathering, allotted drinking, and return are coordinated until a community violates the rhythm that sustains it.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: A scout and lead animal order the grazing herd
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A scout seeks pasture, a lead animal sets direction, the herd moves out in successive groups, and sheep spread to graze at night.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: pasture scout `quranic:root_000610:B003/m01`; herd or cattle group `quranic:root_000532:B014/m01`; successive groups sent to pasture or water `quranic:root_000563:B005/m01`; lead animal followed by the herd `quranic:root_001444:B008/m01`; sheep spreading for night grazing `quranic:root_001503:B006/m01`.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The scene makes collective movement directional rather than random: reconnaissance precedes release, leadership sets the line, and separate groups remain one managed herd. This materially pressures the surah's crowds and collectives, whose apparent mass never places them outside a governing direction.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A herd remains viable through directed group movement between scouted pasture, water, and return.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Pastoral order supplies a concrete model for the surah's collective motion: sending, gathering, allotted drinking, and return are coordinated until a community violates the rhythm that sustains it.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Night watering completes a pasture-return circuit
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Animals are driven toward water at night, watered at the mouth in a drinking cohort, moved to nearby pasture, and brought back after ranging.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: night drive toward a watering place `quranic:root_001212:B008/m01`; drawing water at camels' mouths `quranic:root_001198:B014/m01`; drinking cohort or shared watering group `quranic:root_000783:B003/m01`; livestock circuit between water and pasture `quranic:root_001486:B006/m01`; ranging back and forth in pasture `quranic:root_000610:B004/m01`; evening return of livestock `quranic:root_000609:B005/m01`.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The P2 drinking share belongs to a larger husbandry rhythm in which access, movement, and return are interdependent. Violating the attended turn therefore breaks more than a quota: it tears the communal circuit that converts water into continued life.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, ortak çekirdeği bir varlığı harekete geçirip göndermek ya da elde tutmayı bırakıp salmak olarak kurar. İnsan, elçi, rüzgar, yağmur ve başka güçler bu işlemin farklı nesneleridir; bunlar ayrı birer çekirdek anlam değildir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, gönderme ve serbest bırakmayı kapsar; yalnızca yavaşlık, süt veya sürü bildiren eşsesli kullanımları kapsamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın dalın gönderme ve salıverme çekirdeğiyle sınırlıdır; öteki dallardaki kalıba bağlı anlamlar buraya taşınmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir insanı, canlıyı, doğal gücü ya da başka bir şeyi bulunduğu yerden harekete geçirip bir yöne göndermek; kimi bağlamlarda elde tutmayı bırakıp serbestçe gitmesine izin vermektir.

facets.statement: Temel işlem, bir varlığı durduğu veya tutulduğu konumdan çıkarıp ileri yöneltmektir.
Bir kişi görev veya haber için, rüzgar ve yağmur gibi güçler de etkilerini göstermek üzere gönderilebilir.
Tutmanın karşıtı olarak kullanım, eldeki canlıyı ya da denetlenen gücü salıvermeyi anlatır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, harekete geçirip yollama çekirdeğinde birleşir; görevle gönderme, doğal güçleri yöneltme ve tutulanı serbest bırakma bu çekirdeğin kapsam içi gerçekleşmeleridir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi iş, konuşma ve okumada aceleyi bırakıp sakin, ölçülü ve denetimli ilerlemeyi ortak çekirdek yapar. Çerçevedeki yavaşlık, ağırbaşlılık ve dikkat bu çekirdeğin birbirini tamamlayan yönleridir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, acele etmeden ölçülü davranma ve okumayı kapsar; ardışık topluluk veya taşınan ileti anlamını kapsamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Genel temkin niteliği korunur; yavaş ol buyruğu, iş ve konuşmadaki tutum ile okumadaki açık söyleyiş kendi kullanım sınırlarında ayrılır.

concept_map.definition: Bir işi, konuşmayı veya okumayı aceleye getirmeden; sakinlik, ağırbaşlılık, dikkat ve denetimle yürütmektir.

facets.statement: Çekirdek, aceleyi bırakıp ölçülü ve denetimli ilerlemektir.
İş ve konuşmada sakinlik, ağırbaşlılık ve karar vermeden önce sağlamlaştırma öne çıkar.
Okumada metni acele etmeden açık, belirgin ve dikkatli söyleme kastedilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, acele etmeme buyruğunu ve iş, konuşma, okuma alanlarındaki sakin, dikkatli ilerleyişi ortak bir ölçülülük çekirdeğinde birleştirir.

concept_gloss.applicability: İş, konuşma ve okuma alanlarında ortak olan sakinlik ve denetim niteliğini verir.

error_profile.preserves: Acele etmeme, sakinlik, dikkat ve kontrollü ilerleme bileşenlerini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişiye yavaşlaması ve işi ölçülü yürütmesi söylendiğinde doğal buyruktur.

error_profile.preserves: Acele etmeme ve sakin davranma isteğini korur.
error_profile.loses: Okumadaki açık söyleyiş ve işteki sağlamlaştırma ayrıntılarını belirtmez.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Metnin acele edilmeden açık ve belirgin biçimde okunması bağlamında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Okumada yavaşlık, açıklık ve denetimi korur.
error_profile.loses: İş ve genel konuşmadaki ağırbaşlı tutumu kapsamaz.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, insan veya hayvanların tek bir kütle halinde değil, biri ötekinin ardından gelen ayrı kümeler halinde gelişini ve bu kümelerin her birini anlatır. Çerçeve, topluluk ile ardışıklık bileşenlerini birlikte korur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, peş peşe gelen ayrı toplulukları ve sürüleri kapsar; haber taşıyıcısını veya sütün kendisini kapsamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım ardışık topluluk çekirdeğini korur; tek sürü adı ile grup grup gelme anlatımı kendi sözcük biçimlerinde ayrılır.

concept_map.definition: İnsanların, develerin, koyunların veya başka varlıkların ayrı topluluklar halinde, bir küme ötekinin ardından gelecek biçimde ilerlemesi ya da bu kümelerin her biridir.

facets.statement: Kurucu yapı, birbirini izleyen ayrı toplulukların oluşturduğu ardışıklıktır.
Hayvanlar söz konusu olduğunda her küme bir sürü, otlağa veya suya salınan topluluk olabilir.
İnsan ve at topluluklarında da grup grup, biri diğerinin ardından gelme anlatılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, deve, koyun, at veya insan kümelerinin ayrı gruplar halinde birbirini izlemesini ve her bir hayvan kümesinin sürü olarak adlandırılmasını birlikte verir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Topluluk birimlerini ve bu birimlerin ardışık gelişini birlikte taşıyan en doğal kısa karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Ayrı gruplar ile birbirini izleme düzenini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: İnsanların, atların veya başka varlıkların ayrı kümeler halinde art arda gelişi anlatıldığında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Ayrı kümeler halinde birbirini izlemeyi korur.
error_profile.loses: Her kümenin kalıcı bir sürü adı olabilmesini açıkça göstermez.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Deve veya koyunlardan oluşan tek bir topluluk adlandırıldığında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Hayvan topluluğu birimini korur.
error_profile.loses: Bir sürünün ardından bir başkasının gelmesi düzenini tek başına göstermez.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: deve, koyun veya başka varlıklardan oluşan sürü

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi sözcüğü süt için kullanır, bol ve art arda meme akışını bu adlandırmanın gerekçesi olarak verir ve bir topluluğun hayvanlarından süt elde etmesini aynı dala bağlar. Çerçeve madde, akış ve elde edilebilirlik ayrımlarını korur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal sütü, özellikle bol ve sürekli gelen sütü kapsar; sürü, ileti veya genel bolluk anlamlarını kapsamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım süt çekirdeğini korur; sütün bolluğu ile bir topluluğun hayvanlarından süt elde eder hale gelmesi ayrı sözcük kullanımları olarak tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Hayvandan elde edilen süt, özellikle memeden bol ve art arda gelen süt; ayrıca bir topluluğun hayvanlarından süt elde eder duruma gelmesidir.

facets.statement: Dalın somut çekirdeği hayvandan elde edilen süttür.
Sütün bol olması ve memeden kesintisiz ya da art arda gelmesi özellikle vurgulanabilir.
Topluluğa uygulanan kullanım, hayvanlarının süt vermesi sayesinde süt sahibi duruma gelmelerini anlatır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar sözcüğü süt için verir; bolluk ve memeden sürekli geliş niteliğini belirtir, ayrıca hayvanlarından süt elde etmeye başlayan topluluğu aynı anlam alanına bağlar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Dalın süt maddesini ve özellikle belirtilen ardışık akış niteliğini birlikte temsil eder.

error_profile.preserves: Sütü, bolluğunu ve sürekli akışını korur.
error_profile.loses: Bir topluluğun hayvanlarından süt elde eder duruma gelmesi uzantısını doğrudan adlandırmaz.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Maddenin kendisi kastedildiğinde en yalın doğal karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Dalın somut süt çekirdeğini korur.
error_profile.loses: Bolluk, sürekli akış ve topluluğun süt sahibi oluşu ayrıntılarını göstermez.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir topluluğun hayvanları süt vermeye başladığında kullanılan yapıyı açıklar.

error_profile.loses: Sütün bol ve sürekli akması niteliğini zorunlu kılmaz.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, kişinin iç dünyasının birine veya bir şeye yönelmesini; yabancılık duygusunun kalkıp güven, rahatlık ve açıklık doğmasını anlatır. Çerçeve bu iç yöneliş ile dışa açılma sonucunu doğru bağlar.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, birine veya bir şeye ısınıp yanında rahatça açılmayı kapsar; yavaş okuma veya genel gönderme anlamını kapsamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Anlam, birine ya da bir şeye yönelmeyi belirten yapılarla sınırlıdır; yalın köke genel bir yakınlık anlamı yüklenmez.

facets.statement: Kişinin iç yönelişi, yabancılıktan yakınlık ve güvene geçiş oluşturur.
Bu güvenin görünür sonucu, karşısındakinin yanında rahat ve açık davranmaktır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi karşılıklı haberleşmeyi, atışma gibi bir uğraşta kişinin yanında duran eşliği ve şarkı ya da işte öncekinin ardından gitmeyi aynı karşılıklılık ve izleme alanında toplar. Çerçeve bu özel katılımcı rollerini doğru korur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, karşılıklı iletişim ve ortak uğraşta eşlik edip izlemeyi kapsar; tek yönlü gönderiyi veya yalnızca taşınan iletiyi kapsamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım karşılıklı haberleşme, yarışma eşliği ve şarkı ya da işte izleme biçimlerini kendi yapılara bağlı tutar; yalın köke genel arkadaşlık anlamı verilmez.

concept_map.definition: İki kişinin karşılıklı haberleşmesi veya ortak bir uğraşta birbirine ayak uydurması; özellikle atışma gibi bir işte yanında durması ya da şarkı ve çalışmada öncekinin ardından gitmesidir.

facets.statement: Çekirdek, iki taraf arasında karşılıklı gönderim veya birinin ötekini izlemesiyle kurulan eşgüdümdür.

Yalnız iki damar kullanımını verir; öteki özel adlandırmaları içermez.
